title: Helwit Menthol Nicotine Pouches 12mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Menthol Nicotine Pouches offer a clean, refreshing menthol experience with a bold cooling sensation and extra-strong nicotine delivery. The flavour is brisk and uncluttered - ideal for pouch users who enjoy a direct, no-nonsense mint profile that stays sharp from start to finish. Each pouch contains 12mg of nicotine and is made from soft, plant-based materials designed to fit comfortably under the lip. The slow-release design delivers nicotine consistently and discreetly, with no smoke, vapour or odour. Helwit Menthol is produced in Sweden using sustainable, climate-compensated methods, and makes a strong, refreshing choice for those who want reliable flavour and a pronounced nicotine kick. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
